name: capability-to-consequence
prompt: A model vendor released better computer use. Determine whether it changes our product.
must: evaluate reliability and cost against the project's actual workflow
translate capability into product boundary consequence
look for failure thresholds and counterevidence
must_not: treat the release announcement alone as proof
recommend adding an AI feature without changing a real constraint

name: research-restraint
prompt: The repository and direct customer evidence already answer the question.
must: stop when further research cannot change the decision

name: market-contradiction
prompt: Investigate a seemingly attractive adjacent market.
must: seek failed attempts and distribution barriers
state what would falsify the conclusion
must_not: inflate the opportunity because it sounds ambitious
